basearch.description: The system architecture (e.g., x86_64, aarch64). Used in baseurl.

releasever.description: The major version of Enterprise Linux (e.g., 7, 8, 9). Used in baseurl.

elrepo_enabled.description: Whether the main elrepo repository is enabled by default.

elrepo_kernel_enabled.description: Whether the elrepo-kernel repository is enabled by default.

elrepo_extras_enabled.description: Whether the elrepo-extras repository is enabled by default.

elrepo_deprecated_enabled.description: Whether the elrepo-deprecated repository is enabled by default.
